notes: And when is one rendering of the opening waw (rule 55), headed on the coordinator with when named as the competing head; the later apodosis waw, for which the ASV writes no connective, is unrepresented.
of grain is taken as the ASV's completion of the lexeme of the heap under rule 31 and kept in that noun's unit; the alternative of marking it added is noted on the unit.
softly fuses the preposition with its noun under rules 30 and 40, the assimilated article going unrepresented.
